Title: Stream Analytics supports output to Azure Data Lake Storage Gen 2

Body.Content: Azure Stream Analytics now offers output adapter for egress to Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2 – A highly scalable and cost-effective data lake solution for big data analytics. More detailed information can be found in our output adapters documentation.
